pairs.evidence: app/_components/table/FilterMenu.tsx:59 The active option follows an array position, so refreshing or reordering options while the popup remains open can silently change the keyboard selection.

techniques.evidence: app/_components/table/filter-a11y.test.ts:43 The keyboard test checks source case labels rather than driving keys and observing focus or active-option changes.
app/_components/table/ColumnFilter.tsx:117 The filter popup is conditionally mounted; closing removes its controls instead of merely concealing them.
app/_components/table/FilterMenu.tsx:59 Active identity is positional; option changes can retarget it without a deliberate handoff, and option buttons also remain individual Tab stops.
app/_components/table/TableStatus.tsx:50 Successive filters producing the same count and sort state render identical text without an event-keyed mutation, losing repeated outcome announcements.
app/_components/table/ColumnHead.tsx:62 The icon-only sort control receives a translated name that identifies its column.
app/_components/table/ColumnFilter.tsx:96 The shared icon trigger exposes applied-filter state only through a hidden colored dot; aria-expanded conveys popup visibility instead.

techniques.evidence: app/features/shell/nav/navDrawerA11y.test.ts:20 The hidden-drawer test checks a predicate rather than verifying zero hidden Tab stops or the computed accessibility tree.

app/_components/Toast.tsx:72 AnimatePresence retains exiting cards for this visual transition, while their controls receive no corresponding inertness boundary.
app/_components/Toast.tsx:95 Keyboard dismissal removes the focused toast control without transferring focus to a meaningful survivor.
app/_components/Toast.tsx:135 Each toast mounts its own populated region; duplicate events retain the same card key and message, and the visual stack supplies no serial announcement drain.
app/_components/Tooltip.tsx:98 aria-describedby belongs on the described control; its relationship is not inherited from this wrapper.
